armyRules.name: Waaagh!
armyRules.text:
Friendly **ORKS** with this ability can:
- Re-roll **advance rolls**.
- Become **riled up**, as stated in other rules.
While a unit is **riled up**:
    - That unit has 5+ **InSv**.
    - That unit's ranged attacks have **[ASSAULT]**.
    - When that unit is selected to make an **advance move**, that **advance move** does not prevent that unit from being **eligible to declare a charge**.

armyRules.name: Da Boss

armyRules.name: Unstable Energies
armyRules.text:
**ORKS PSYKER** units with this ability have a **psyker level** of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each **psychic ability** has a **psychic level** of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name.
In a battle round, a friendly **ORKS PSYKER** unit can use a number of **psychic abilities** whose total **psychic level** does not exceed that **PSYKER** unit's **psyker level**.

armyRules.name: Special Move Types
armyRules.text:
The following are special move types that certain or all of your units are eligible to make.

PULSE JET MOVE

MAXIMUM DISTANCE: Pulse roll + 18"

ELIGIBLE IF: As stated in the rule allowing this move type.

EFFECT: Your unit moves as described in Moving (Core Rules, 03).

BEFORE MOVING:

- Make a pulse roll by rolling one D6.

WHILE MOVING:

- Ignore all vertical distance for the purposes of how far your unit has moved.

- Your unit can move through all types of model.

- Your unit can move horizontally and vertically through all categories of terrain feature.

AFTER MOVING:

- Your unit must be unengaged.

- Until the end of the turn, your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or start an action.

- Until the start of your next turn, attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

ASSAULT DISEMBARK MOVE18.06

SET-UP DISTANCE: 3"

ELIGIBLE IF:

- Embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield

- Did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase

- That TRANSPORT has not made an advance/fall-back move this phase

EFFECT: Set up as described in Set Up (03.02).

WHILE MOVING: Set up each model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.

rule.text: Friendly **ORKS** units' melee attacks have **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]**.

Breakin' Heads.name: BREAKIN' HEADS
Breakin' Heads.when: Any phase, when a friendly attached ORKS INFANTRY unit becomes battle-shocked.
Breakin' Heads.target: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked.
Breakin' Heads.effect:
Roll one D3:

- Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result.

- Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.
Breakin' Heads.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly attached ORKS INFANTRY unit becomes battle-shocked.

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked.

EFFECT: Roll one D3:

- Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result.

- Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.
Breakin' Heads.flavour: Sometimes even the most enthusiastic Orks need a little ‘encouragement’ to stay in the fight.

Orks Is Never Beaten.name: ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN
Orks Is Never Beaten.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding TITANIC units).
Orks Is Never Beaten.effect:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up:

- On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
Orks Is Never Beaten.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding TITANIC units).

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up:

- On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
Orks Is Never Beaten.flavour: So resilient is Ork physiology - and so slow are Orks on the uptake - even death can take time to register.

Mow 'Em Down.effect:

TARGET: That ORKS VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have:

- Or: If that attack already has [CLEAVE], +1 to the value of that [CLEAVE] (e.g. [CLEAVE 1] becomes [CLEAVE 2]).
Mow 'Em Down.flavour: Spiked rams, deff rollas and glyph-heavy dozer blades are more than just stylish statements for the crew of Ork vehicles.

Fungus-Fuel Injection.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit is selected to move.

Glowin' Dakka.name: GLOWIN' DAKKA

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

Dubious Restraint.flavour: A few Orks, particularly those of a rebelliously disciplined outlook, can resist their destructive urges just long enough to prioritise strategic gains.

Mind Mostly on the Mission.name: MIND MOSTLY ON THE MISSION

While Their Backs Are Turned.flavour: With the gitz they were fighting having scarpered, mobs with a plan exploit the sudden lull to press towards whatever target has next caught their eye.

Drive-By Bustin'.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS TRANSPORT unit is selected to shoot.
Drive-By Bustin'.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks with weapons selected for the Firing Deck ability have +1 to hit rolls.

Gun-Crazy Show-Offs.flavour: With a snort of contempt, these Orks decide to show the gitz who just shot at them what real guns are capable of.

Instinctive Hunters.name: INSTINCTIVE HUNTERS

rule.name: 6 - Runitified
rule.text: The target unit has -1 **T** until your unit has shot.

Vindictive Artillerists.name: VINDICTIVE ARTILLERISTS
Vindictive Artillerists.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MEK GUNZ unit is selected to shoot.

Your unit’s ranged attacks have:

rule.name: Try Dat Button!
rule.text:
In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly **ORKS WALKER** unit (excluding **TITANIC** units) is **selected to attack**, you can use this ability. If you do, roll either one D6 or two D6 (keep re-rolling duplicate results). This unit's attacks have the relevant rule(s).

If you rolled two D6, when this unit has attacked, this unit makes one **hazard roll**.

Crazed Rampage.effect:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +3 to the result if your unit has DEFF DREAD:

- On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

Dread Power.name: DREAD POWER

WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly ORKS WALKER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.
Dread Power.flavour: Fuelled by the pilot’s obsession or psychosis - and powered up by varied erratic gubbinz - it is little wonder that a Kan’s stomping rampages are constantly reignited.

Stomping Juggernaut.name: STOMPING JUGGERNAUT
Stomping Juggernaut.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
Stomping Juggernaut.text:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That ORKS WALKER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.
Stomping Juggernaut.flavour: A pilot’s single-mindedness and his walker’s durable form mean few obstacles can impede its relentless stomping advance.

enhancements.name: - Cybork Boosta
enhancements.text: **BIG MEK/MEK** model only. This model has +2" **M**.

enhancements.name: - Dreadherder
enhancements.text:
**BIG MEK** model only. While this model is within 3" of a friendly **ORKS WALKER** unit (excluding **BIG MEK** units):
- This model has **Lone Operative**.
- In your Shooting phase, you can select one friendly **ORKS WALKER** unit within 3" of this model. That unit's attacks can re-roll **hit rolls** of 1 until the end of the turn.

rule.name: Unstoppable Momentum
rule.text:
- Friendly **WAGON** units can re-roll **charge rolls**.
- When a friendly **WAGON** unit is selected to make an **advance move**, that unit can change **advance rolls** to a 6.

Keep It Runnin'.name: KEEP IT RUNNIN'
Keep It Runnin'.target: One friendly unengaged ORKS INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within.
Keep It Runnin'.effect: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.
Keep It Runnin'.text:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ORKS INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within.

EFFECT: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.
Keep It Runnin'.flavour: The crews of the Orks’ hulking transports maintain a high level of readiness for when the ladz get bored and rapidly clamber back on board to look for a new fight.

Readied Brawlers.name: READIED BRAWLERS
Readied Brawlers.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a normal move.
Readied Brawlers.effect: Units embarked within your unit can make an assault disembark move.
Readied Brawlers.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a normal move.

TARGET: That WAGON unit.

EFFECT: Units embarked within your unit can make an assault disembark move.
Readied Brawlers.flavour: Bursting from assault hatches, pounding down boarding ramps or leaping from handholds, this thuggish transport’s fighters are quick to pile out.

Impending Krunch.name: IMPENDING KRUNCH
Impending Krunch.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a charge move.
Impending Krunch.effect: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
Impending Krunch.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That WAGON unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
Impending Krunch.flavour: Having several tons of metal covered in blood, rust and spikes bearing down on them can shake the resolve of the most stoic warriors.

enhancements.name: - Targetin' GizmosUPGRADE
enhancements.text:
WAGON unit only. While a BIG MEK model is embarked within this unit:

- If this unit is riled up, this unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

enhancements.name: - Boss BoomerUPGRADE
enhancements.text: WAGON unit only. While a WARBOSS model is embarked within this unit, this unit has that WARBOSS model’s Intimidating Motivation/Keep Huntin’ ability.

rule.name: Adrenaline Junkies
rule.text:
- Friendly **WARBIKERS** units have **BATTLELINE**.
- When a friendly **SPEED FREEKS** unit is selected to make an **advance/fall-back move**:
    - That unit's ranged attacks have **[ASSAULT]** until the end of the turn.
    - That move does not prevent that unit from being **eligible to declare a charge**.

Delicious Eating Squigs.name: DELICIOUS EATING SQUIGS
Delicious Eating Squigs.effect: Select any number of friendly ORKS INFANTRY units within 3" of your unit. Each selected unit heals 3 wounds.
Delicious Eating Squigs.text:

EFFECT: Select any number of friendly ORKS INFANTRY units within 3" of your unit. Each selected unit heals 3 wounds.
Delicious Eating Squigs.flavour: Besides more dangerous fare, Squig-lobbing buggies fire edible Squigs for a price, guaranteed to enliven any Ork if he can eat it before it eats him.

Dakkastorm.name: DAKKASTORM

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].
Dakkastorm.flavour: Often all an enemy will see of a Kult of Speed is a dust cloud as they speed by, all guns blazing.

Speediest Freeks.name: SPEEDIEST FREEKS

Speediest Freeks.flavour: Speed Freeks are often just blurs of vehicular mayhem that prove difficult to land a blow on.

enhancements.name: - Competitive Streak
enhancements.text: **DEFFKILLA WARTRIKE** model only. This unit can re-roll **charge rolls**.

rule.name: Skyborne Loons

- While a friendly **ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS** unit is **riled up**, this unit's ranged attacks have +1 to **hit rolls**.

Flyin' Headbutt.name: FLYIN' HEADBUTT

Your unit does not have the Deadly Demise ability. Select one enemy unit within 12" of your unit and roll eight D6:

- For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Then remove your unit from the battlefield.
Flyin' Headbutt.flavour: Some Ork pilots, out of bullets and out of luck, brighten up considerably when they realise their own aircraft is a deadly weapon in its own right.

Long, Uncontrolled Bursts.name: LONG, UNCONTROLLED BURSTS

Long, Uncontrolled Bursts.flavour: Ork Flyboyz will fill the skies with dakka in an attempt to down any enemy they think is muscling in on their aerial turf.

Whirligig Evasion.name: WHIRLIGIG EVASION

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:

- Up to D6".

- Or: If your unit is riled up, up to 6".
Whirligig Evasion.flavour: Enemy attempts to hunt Deffkoptas down can be stymied by nimble aerial evasion, usually accompanied by a crude hand gesture in the foe’s direction.

rule.name: Void WAAAGH!
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Waaagh! ability retain that ability and gain this one.

Once per battle, at the start of the battle round, you can call a Void Waaagh!. If you do, until the start of the next battle round, the Void Waaagh! is active for your army and:

- Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models from your army with this ability.

- Models from your army with this ability have a 5+ invulnerable save. A Void Waaagh! counts as a Waaagh! for any datasheet abilities.

rule.name: Belligerent Boarders
rule.text: Each time an attack targets an ORKS unit from your army (excluding GROTS units), if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of that ORKS unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Pile Through.name: PILE THROUGH
Pile Through.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
Pile Through.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.
Pile Through.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.
Pile Through.flavour: Orks react to the sudden availability of a good scrap with immediate and enthusiastic aggression.

Ramboyz Rampage.name: RAMBOYZ RAMPAGE
Ramboyz Rampage.target: One BOYZ unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Ramboyz Rampage.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced and each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll; instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
Ramboyz Rampage.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One BOYZ unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced and each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll; instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
Ramboyz Rampage.flavour: These ramship-riding Orks emulate the actions of their warship by barrelling full-tilt towards the enemy while roaring like lunatics then crashing into them head-on.

Eager to Fight.name: EAGER TO FIGHT
Eager to Fight.when: Your Movement phase, in the Reinforcements step, just after an ORKS unit from your army is set up in an Entry Zone.
Eager to Fight.effect: Your unit can make an Advance move.
Eager to Fight.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, in the Reinforcements step, just after an ORKS unit from your army is set up in an Entry Zone.

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make an Advance move.
Eager to Fight.flavour: Impatient from being bottled up aboard their voidships with no one to clobber, this mob cannot wait to get stuck in to a proper scrap.

Enraged Rush.name: ENRAGED RUSH
Enraged Rush.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Enraged Rush.target: One BOYZ unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Enraged Rush.effect: Your unit can make an Enraged Rush move. To do so, roll one D6: your unit can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but must end that move as close as possible to the attacking unit. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, but only that enemy unit.
Enraged Rush.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One BOYZ unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make an Enraged Rush move. To do so, roll one D6: your unit can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but must end that move as close as possible to the attacking unit. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, but only that enemy unit.
Enraged Rush.flavour: Shooting this mob only serves to attract their attention while simultaneously making them angry at such a blatant attempt to deny them a good punch up.

enhancements.name: Living Battering Ram
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer attempts to operate a closed Hatchway, your opponent cannot try to prevent it. In addition, each time the bearer opens a Hatchway, each enemy unit within 6" of that Hatchway and wholly on the opposite side of it from the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Scarred Brute
enhancements.text: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

rule.name: Comin’ Through
rule.text: In your Movement phase, Desperate Escape tests taken for ORKS models from your army are automatically passed and each time an ORKS unit from your army makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through other models as if they were not there, provided those other models have a lower Toughness characteristic than it.

Loot on the Move.name: LOOT ON THE MOVE
Loot on the Move.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
Loot on the Move.effect: Until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed. Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Loot on the Move.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed. Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Loot on the Move.flavour: Not only does ripping a door hatch right off its hinges allow for ease of progress, but the resultant large slab of bulletproof metal can make a handy temporary shield.

Pile Through.name: PILE THROUGH
Pile Through.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.
Pile Through.flavour: Orks react to the sudden availability of a good scrap with immediate and enthusiastic aggression.

Pit Fighter.name: PIT FIGHTER
Pit Fighter.target: One WARBOSS model from your army.
Pit Fighter.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Pit Fighter.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One WARBOSS model from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Pit Fighter.flavour: This Warboss is a terror of the fighting pits, single-mindedly battering his way through lesser foes or simply sweeping them aside as he carves a path towards his true quarry.

Cornered and Krumped.name: CORNERED AND KRUMPED
Cornered and Krumped.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
Cornered and Krumped.target: One ORKS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
Cornered and Krumped.effect: Your unit can fight as if it were the Fight phase, but when doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit.
Cornered and Krumped.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.

TARGET: One ORKS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can fight as if it were the Fight phase, but when doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit.
Cornered and Krumped.flavour: It is no easy thing to disentangle from a mob of ferocious Orks and retreat in good order, especially when cornered by them within the claustrophobic confines of a voidship.

enhancements.name: Tellyporta
enhancements.text: In the Deploy Armies step, select one **^^Meganobz^^** unit from your army. Until the end of the battle, models in that unit have the Deep Strike ability.

enhancements.name: Gnasher Squig Crates
enhancements.text: **^^Warboss^^** model only. In your Command phase, you can select one **^^Nobz^^** or **^^Meganobz^^** unit from your army (excluding Battle-shocked units) that is within 6" of the bearer and is within range of an objective marker. If there are no enemy models within range of that objective marker, it is Secured by your army.

breakinheads.name: BREAKIN' HEADS
breakinheads.when: Any phase, when a friendly attached ORKS INFANTRY unit becomes battle-shocked.
breakinheads.target: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked.
breakinheads.effect:
Roll one D3:

- Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result.

- Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.
breakinheads.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly attached ORKS INFANTRY unit becomes battle-shocked.

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked.

EFFECT: Roll one D3:

- Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result.

- Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.
breakinheads.flavour: Sometimes even the most enthusiastic Orks need a little ‘encouragement’ to stay in the fight.

hitemharder.name: HIT 'EM HARDER
hitemharder.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight.
hitemharder.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].
hitemharder.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].
hitemharder.flavour: Even the weediest Orks possess great strength, and need little persuasion to bring it to bear.

orksisneverbeaten.name: ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN
orksisneverbeaten.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding TITANIC units).
orksisneverbeaten.effect:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up:

- On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
orksisneverbeaten.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding TITANIC units).

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up:

- On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
orksisneverbeaten.flavour: So resilient is Ork physiology - and so slow are Orks on the uptake - even death can take time to register.

mowemdown.name: MOW 'EM DOWN
mowemdown.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS VEHICLE unit (excluding WALKER units) that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
mowemdown.effect:
Your unit’s melee attacks have:

- [Cleave 1].

- Or: If that attack already has [CLEAVE], +1 to the value of that [CLEAVE] (e.g. [CLEAVE 1] becomes [CLEAVE 2]).
mowemdown.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS VEHICLE unit (excluding WALKER units) that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.

TARGET: That ORKS VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have:

- [Cleave 1].

- Or: If that attack already has [CLEAVE], +1 to the value of that [CLEAVE] (e.g. [CLEAVE 1] becomes [CLEAVE 2]).
mowemdown.flavour: Spiked rams, deff rollas and glyph-heavy dozer blades are more than just stylish statements for the crew of Ork vehicles.

fungusfuelinjection.name: FUNGUS-FUEL INJECTION
fungusfuelinjection.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit is selected to move.
fungusfuelinjection.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit is selected to move.

TARGET: That ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has +2" M.
fungusfuelinjection.flavour: Fermented through entirely unstable processes, just a drop of these potent additives can supercharge any Mek-built engine.

closerangedakka.name: CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA
closerangedakka.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot.
closerangedakka.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:

- [Rapid Fire 1].

- Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).
closerangedakka.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:

- [Rapid Fire 1].

- Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).
closerangedakka.flavour: Many Orks think it’s a waste of time blazing away at long range, when it’s more fun to see the effects of potent dakka up close.

unbridledcarnage.name: UNBRIDLED CARNAGE
unbridledcarnage.when: Fight phase, when a friendly BOYZ unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
unbridledcarnage.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 A.
unbridledcarnage.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly BOYZ unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.

TARGET: That BOYZ unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 A.
unbridledcarnage.flavour: When da Boyz get stuck into the foe, the carnage is wonderful to behold, at least for all their mates.

mobmentality.name: MOB MENTALITY
mobmentality.when: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase.
mobmentality.target: One friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit of 13+ models.
mobmentality.effect: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.
mobmentality.text:
WHEN: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit of 13+ models.

EFFECT: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.
mobmentality.flavour: With volleys of wagers, threats, insults, dung and the occasional rock, large mobs bolster the spirits of others in the most Orky ways possible.

erewego.name: 'ERE WE GO
erewego.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ/BOYZ unit is selected to move.
erewego.effect: Your unit has +2 to advance rolls.
erewego.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ/BOYZ unit is selected to move.

TARGET: That BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ/BOYZ unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has +2 to advance rolls.
erewego.flavour: Orks can put on a surprising turn of speed when the promise of a good face-to-face fight is in the offing.

tooarroganttodie.name: TOO ARROGANT TO DIE
tooarroganttodie.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.
tooarroganttodie.effect:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up:

- On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
tooarroganttodie.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

TARGET: That MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up:

- On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
tooarroganttodie.flavour: With bone-headed arrogance, Nobz will carry on killing before their deaths finally dawn on them.

armedtodateef.name: ARMED TO DA TEEF
armedtodateef.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit is selected to attack.
armedtodateef.effect:
Your unit’s attacks can:

- Re-roll hit rolls of 1.

- If your unit is riled up, re-roll hit rolls.
armedtodateef.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit is selected to attack.

TARGET: That MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks can:

- Re-roll hit rolls of 1.

- If your unit is riled up, re-roll hit rolls.
armedtodateef.flavour: Nobz load themselves with all manner of weapons in shows of wealth and influence.

hulkingbrutes.name: HULKING BRUTES
hulkingbrutes.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.
hulkingbrutes.effect:
Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

+1CP
hulkingbrutes.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

TARGET: That MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.

+1CP
hulkingbrutes.flavour: The thick armour and thicker skulls of Nobz make them a daunting prospect to gun down.

infestedwarzone.name: INFESTED WAR ZONE
infestedwarzone.when: Any phase, when an enemy unit has attacked.
infestedwarzone.target: One friendly GRETCHIN unit that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though that unit was just destroyed.
infestedwarzone.effect: Add a new GRETCHIN unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in strategic reserves, at its starting strength, with its full wounds remaining.
infestedwarzone.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when an enemy unit has attacked.

TARGET: One friendly GRETCHIN unit that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though that unit was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Add a new GRETCHIN unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in strategic reserves, at its starting strength, with its full wounds remaining.
infestedwarzone.flavour: Short, scrawny and skilled at hiding, there are usually a lot more Gretchin about than meets the eye.

scarper.name: SCARPER!
scarper.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged GRETCHIN unit.
scarper.effect:
Your unit can make a normal move of:

- Up to D6".

- Or: Up to 6" instead if your unit is an attached unit.
scarper.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged GRETCHIN unit.

TARGET: That GRETCHIN unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:

- Up to D6".

- Or: Up to 6" instead if your unit is an attached unit.
scarper.flavour: Through natural cowardice or a Runtherd’s threats, Grots’ agile reactions can leave foes flat-footed.

grotshields.name: GROT SHIELDS
grotshields.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit (excluding GRETCHIN units).
grotshields.target: One friendly GRETCHIN unit within 3" of that ORKS INFANTRY unit.
grotshields.effect: When a hit roll for that enemy unit’s ranged attacks that target that ORKS unit results in a hit, if a model in your GRETCHIN unit is on the battlefield, end the attack sequence for that attack and your GRETCHIN unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
grotshields.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit (excluding GRETCHIN units).

TARGET: One friendly GRETCHIN unit within 3" of that ORKS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: When a hit roll for that enemy unit’s ranged attacks that target that ORKS unit results in a hit, if a model in your GRETCHIN unit is on the battlefield, end the attack sequence for that attack and your GRETCHIN unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
grotshields.flavour: Despite their protestations, Gretchin make surprisingly effective bullet shields.

kustomdakka.name: KUSTOM DAKKA
kustomdakka.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.
kustomdakka.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 to wound rolls.
kustomdakka.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 to wound rolls.
kustomdakka.flavour: Extra speshul ammunition is hoarded by those Orks obsessed with dakka, ready for the ideal target when it is splurged in an impressively killy display.

glowindakka.name: GLOWIN' DAKKA
glowindakka.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.
glowindakka.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 AP.
glowindakka.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 AP.
glowindakka.flavour: Semi-molten or radioactive slugs; frazzle bullets; shokktastik shells; Orks will try anything they can afford to crack open enemy armour in style.

neverenoughdakka.name: NEVER ENOUGH DAKKA
neverenoughdakka.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.
neverenoughdakka.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].
neverenoughdakka.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].
neverenoughdakka.flavour: Squeezing the trigger until their weapon stops firing or falls apart in their hands is a standard tactic for many Orks, and their horrifically wild bursts eventually find their mark.

dubiousrestraint.name: DUBIOUS RESTRAINT
dubiousrestraint.effect: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
dubiousrestraint.text:
WHEN: Start/end of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit.

EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.
dubiousrestraint.flavour: A few Orks, particularly those of a rebelliously disciplined outlook, can resist their destructive urges just long enough to prioritise strategic gains.

mindmostlyonthemission.name: MIND MOSTLY ON THE MISSION
mindmostlyonthemission.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.
mindmostlyonthemission.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
mindmostlyonthemission.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.

TARGET: That BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
mindmostlyonthemission.flavour: When there’s a dirty job needs doing, Orks with strange compulsions get a kick out of causing such trouble sneakily or swiftly.

whiletheirbacksareturned.name: WHILE THEIR BACKS ARE TURNED
whiletheirbacksareturned.when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
whiletheirbacksareturned.target: One friendly unengaged BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit that was engaged at the start of the phase.
whiletheirbacksareturned.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6".
whiletheirbacksareturned.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit that was engaged at the start of the phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6".
whiletheirbacksareturned.flavour: With the gitz they were fighting having scarpered, mobs with a plan exploit the sudden lull to press towards whatever target has next caught their eye.

drivebybustin.name: DRIVE-BY BUSTIN'
drivebybustin.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS TRANSPORT unit is selected to shoot.
drivebybustin.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks with weapons selected for the Firing Deck ability have +1 to hit rolls.
drivebybustin.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS TRANSPORT unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS TRANSPORT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks with weapons selected for the Firing Deck ability have +1 to hit rolls.
drivebybustin.flavour: Ork transports are not the smoothest of rides. However, the best loot-hunters have honed their drive-by volleys of armour-cracking firepower to the point of deadly accuracy.

grabit.name: GRAB IT
grabit.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unengaged BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit has shot.
grabit.effect:
- Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6", and must end that move within range of an objective.

- Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.
grabit.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unengaged BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit has shot.

TARGET: That BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit.

EFFECT:

- Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6", and must end that move within range of an objective.

- Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.
grabit.flavour: Wreckin’ some gitz is all well and good, but getting the drop on them and then grabbing an opportunity for some loot is even better.

guncrazyshowoffs.name: GUN-CRAZY SHOW-OFFS
guncrazyshowoffs.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
guncrazyshowoffs.target: One friendly FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit hit by those attacks.
guncrazyshowoffs.effect: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
guncrazyshowoffs.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One friendly FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit hit by those attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
guncrazyshowoffs.flavour: With a snort of contempt, these Orks decide to show the gitz who just shot at them what real guns are capable of.

wheredyafinkyouregoing.name: WHERE D'YA FINK YOU'RE GOING?
wheredyafinkyouregoing.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit.
wheredyafinkyouregoing.effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode. If that enemy unit is a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, that enemy unit makes three additional hazard rolls for each BEAST SNAGGA unit it is engaged with, with -1 from those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.
wheredyafinkyouregoing.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit.

TARGET: That BEAST SNAGGA unit.

EFFECT: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode. If that enemy unit is a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, that enemy unit makes three additional hazard rolls for each BEAST SNAGGA unit it is engaged with, with -1 from those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.
wheredyafinkyouregoing.flavour: Beast Snagga victims often make a break for it before the Orks have tired of fighting. Hooked, impaled or ridden down, few survive such flight.

goadedintoaction.name: GOADED INTO ACTION
goadedintoaction.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
goadedintoaction.target: One friendly unengaged BEAST SNAGGA unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.
goadedintoaction.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is riled up, it can re-roll that D6.
goadedintoaction.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged BEAST SNAGGA unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is riled up, it can re-roll that D6.
goadedintoaction.flavour: Should attempts to obliterate the Beast Snaggas from afar fail, it is often the foe’s last mistake as the hunters turn their baleful attention on them.

instinctivehunters.name: INSTINCTIVE HUNTERS
instinctivehunters.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
instinctivehunters.target: One friendly unengaged BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" of a battlefield edge.
instinctivehunters.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
instinctivehunters.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" of a battlefield edge.

EFFECT: Place your unit in strategic reserves.
instinctivehunters.flavour: With a keen eye for tracking their prey, Beast Snaggas will circle around to ambush the luckless gitz from another angle.

vindictiveartillerists.name: VINDICTIVE ARTILLERISTS
vindictiveartillerists.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MEK GUNZ unit is selected to shoot.
vindictiveartillerists.effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:

- [Lethal Hits].

- Or: [Sustained Hits 1].

- Or: [Hazardous], [Lethal Hits], [Sustained Hits 1].
vindictiveartillerists.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly MEK GUNZ unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That MEK GUNZ unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have:

- [Lethal Hits].

- Or: [Sustained Hits 1].

- Or: [Hazardous], [Lethal Hits], [Sustained Hits 1].
vindictiveartillerists.flavour: Though cowardly, Grot artillery crews will dare to overcharge their weapons in acts of spectacular spite.

crazedrampage.name: CRAZED RAMPAGE
crazedrampage.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding TITANIC units).
crazedrampage.effect:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +3 to the result if your unit has DEFF DREAD:

- On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
crazedrampage.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding TITANIC units).

TARGET: That ORKS WALKER unit.

EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +3 to the result if your unit has DEFF DREAD:

- On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.
crazedrampage.flavour: Even horrific damage will not prevent many Ork combat walkers from crunching and stomping their enemies in a final fugue of psychotic aggression.

dreadpower.name: DREAD POWER
dreadpower.effect: Your unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.
dreadpower.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly ORKS WALKER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.
dreadpower.flavour: Fuelled by the pilot’s obsession or psychosis - and powered up by varied erratic gubbinz - it is little wonder that a Kan’s stomping rampages are constantly reignited.

stompingjuggernaut.name: STOMPING JUGGERNAUT
stompingjuggernaut.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stompingjuggernaut.text:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

TARGET: That ORKS WALKER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.
stompingjuggernaut.flavour: A pilot’s single-mindedness and his walker’s durable form mean few obstacles can impede its relentless stomping advance.

keepitrunnin.name: KEEP IT RUNNIN'
keepitrunnin.target: One friendly unengaged ORKS INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within.
keepitrunnin.effect: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.
keepitrunnin.text:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged ORKS INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within.

EFFECT: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.
keepitrunnin.flavour: The crews of the Orks’ hulking transports maintain a high level of readiness for when the ladz get bored and rapidly clamber back on board to look for a new fight.

readiedbrawlers.name: READIED BRAWLERS
readiedbrawlers.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a normal move.
readiedbrawlers.effect: Units embarked within your unit can make an assault disembark move.
readiedbrawlers.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a normal move.

TARGET: That WAGON unit.

EFFECT: Units embarked within your unit can make an assault disembark move.
readiedbrawlers.flavour: Bursting from assault hatches, pounding down boarding ramps or leaping from handholds, this thuggish transport’s fighters are quick to pile out.

impendingkrunch.name: IMPENDING KRUNCH
impendingkrunch.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a charge move.
impendingkrunch.effect: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
impendingkrunch.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a charge move.

TARGET: That WAGON unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
impendingkrunch.flavour: Having several tons of metal covered in blood, rust and spikes bearing down on them can shake the resolve of the most stoic warriors.

deliciouseatingsquigs.name: DELICIOUS EATING SQUIGS
deliciouseatingsquigs.effect: Select any number of friendly ORKS INFANTRY units within 3" of your unit. Each selected unit heals 3 wounds.
deliciouseatingsquigs.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One friendly RUKKATRUKK SQUIGBUGGIES unit.

EFFECT: Select any number of friendly ORKS INFANTRY units within 3" of your unit. Each selected unit heals 3 wounds.
deliciouseatingsquigs.flavour: Besides more dangerous fare, Squig-lobbing buggies fire edible Squigs for a price, guaranteed to enliven any Ork if he can eat it before it eats him.

dakkastorm.name: DAKKASTORM
dakkastorm.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is selected to shoot.
dakkastorm.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].
dakkastorm.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].
dakkastorm.flavour: Often all an enemy will see of a Kult of Speed is a dust cloud as they speed by, all guns blazing.

speediestfreeks.name: SPEEDIEST FREEKS
speediestfreeks.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit.
speediestfreeks.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3.
speediestfreeks.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit.

TARGET: That SPEED FREEKS unit.

EFFECT: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3.
speediestfreeks.flavour: Speed Freeks are often just blurs of vehicular mayhem that prove difficult to land a blow on.

flyinheadbutt.name: FLYIN' HEADBUTT
flyinheadbutt.when: Any phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT unit is destroyed, before rolling for any Deadly Demise.
flyinheadbutt.effect:
Your unit does not have the Deadly Demise ability. Select one enemy unit within 12" of your unit and roll eight D6:

- For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Then remove your unit from the battlefield.
flyinheadbutt.text:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT unit is destroyed, before rolling for any Deadly Demise.

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit does not have the Deadly Demise ability. Select one enemy unit within 12" of your unit and roll eight D6:

- For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Then remove your unit from the battlefield.
flyinheadbutt.flavour: Some Ork pilots, out of bullets and out of luck, brighten up considerably when they realise their own aircraft is a deadly weapon in its own right.

longuncontrolledbursts.name: LONG, UNCONTROLLED BURSTS
longuncontrolledbursts.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit is selected to shoot.
longuncontrolledbursts.effect: When your unit’s ranged attacks target a FLY unit, those attacks can re-roll hit rolls.
longuncontrolledbursts.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit.

EFFECT: When your unit’s ranged attacks target a FLY unit, those attacks can re-roll hit rolls.
longuncontrolledbursts.flavour: Ork Flyboyz will fill the skies with dakka in an attempt to down any enemy they think is muscling in on their aerial turf.

whirligigevasion.name: WHIRLIGIG EVASION
whirligigevasion.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move.
whirligigevasion.target: One friendly unengaged DEFFKOPTAS unit within 8" of that enemy unit.
whirligigevasion.effect:
Your unit can make a normal move of:

- Up to D6".

- Or: If your unit is riled up, up to 6".
whirligigevasion.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged DEFFKOPTAS unit within 8" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of:

- Up to D6".

- Or: If your unit is riled up, up to 6".
whirligigevasion.flavour: Enemy attempts to hunt Deffkoptas down can be stymied by nimble aerial evasion, usually accompanied by a crude hand gesture in the foe’s direction.

pilethrough.name: PILE THROUGH
pilethrough.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
pilethrough.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.
pilethrough.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit has the Fights First ability.
pilethrough.flavour: Orks react to the sudden availability of a good scrap with immediate and enthusiastic aggression.

ramboyzrampage.name: RAMBOYZ RAMPAGE
ramboyzrampage.target: One BOYZ unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
ramboyzrampage.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced and each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll; instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
ramboyzrampage.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One BOYZ unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced and each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll; instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.
ramboyzrampage.flavour: These ramship-riding Orks emulate the actions of their warship by barrelling full-tilt towards the enemy while roaring like lunatics then crashing into them head-on.

eagertofight.name: EAGER TO FIGHT
eagertofight.when: Your Movement phase, in the Reinforcements step, just after an ORKS unit from your army is set up in an Entry Zone.
eagertofight.effect: Your unit can make an Advance move.
eagertofight.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, in the Reinforcements step, just after an ORKS unit from your army is set up in an Entry Zone.

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make an Advance move.
eagertofight.flavour: Impatient from being bottled up aboard their voidships with no one to clobber, this mob cannot wait to get stuck in to a proper scrap.

enragedrush.name: ENRAGED RUSH
enragedrush.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
enragedrush.target: One BOYZ unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
enragedrush.effect: Your unit can make an Enraged Rush move. To do so, roll one D6: your unit can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but must end that move as close as possible to the attacking unit. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, but only that enemy unit.
enragedrush.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One BOYZ unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make an Enraged Rush move. To do so, roll one D6: your unit can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but must end that move as close as possible to the attacking unit. When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit, but only that enemy unit.
enragedrush.flavour: Shooting this mob only serves to attract their attention while simultaneously making them angry at such a blatant attempt to deny them a good punch up.

lootonthemove.name: LOOT ON THE MOVE
lootonthemove.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.
lootonthemove.effect: Until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed. Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
lootonthemove.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS unit from your army opens a Hatchway.

TARGET: That ORKS unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the battle, that Hatchway cannot be closed. Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
lootonthemove.flavour: Not only does ripping a door hatch right off its hinges allow for ease of progress, but the resultant large slab of bulletproof metal can make a handy temporary shield.

pitfighter.name: PIT FIGHTER
pitfighter.target: One WARBOSS model from your army.
pitfighter.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
pitfighter.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One WARBOSS model from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your model is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
pitfighter.flavour: This Warboss is a terror of the fighting pits, single-mindedly battering his way through lesser foes or simply sweeping them aside as he carves a path towards his true quarry.

corneredandkrumped.name: CORNERED AND KRUMPED
corneredandkrumped.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.
corneredandkrumped.target: One ORKS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
corneredandkrumped.effect: Your unit can fight as if it were the Fight phase, but when doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit.
corneredandkrumped.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is selected to Fall Back.

TARGET: One ORKS unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can fight as if it were the Fight phase, but when doing so, models in your unit can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target) and each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit.
corneredandkrumped.flavour: It is no easy thing to disentangle from a mob of ferocious Orks and retreat in good order, especially when cornered by them within the claustrophobic confines of a voidship.
